tool_args.rationale: The pilot is already at the target horizon, but its largest sink gradient is 2.44, below the candidate onset range of 2.50–2.68. Both siphon models can therefore give identical pilot predictions. The high-gradient probe costs 3.0 and directly tests whether an additional loss appears beyond the threshold.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Compatible with the pilot, but it omits an avalanche term that the pilot cannot test.
All pilot gradients are below the candidate threshold range, so neither the threshold nor the avalanche strength can be estimated.
The pilot varies drive and sink gradient together, so its flattening does not establish a drive-only inhibition mechanism.
It costs more and does not directly target the missing supercritical gradient regime.
